title: Personalized Basketball Flames Flying Over Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the excitement of the court into your bedroom with this custom comforter set by Jeminise. Perfect for basketball players and sports enthusiasts, this bedding features a bold basketball print that can be personalized with a custom name and number to make it uniquely yours.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your own name (up to 30 characters) and number (up to 5 digits) for a truly unique sports-themed look.
  • Soft & Cozy Fabric: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is lightweight, durable, and exceptionally soft to the touch.
  • Premium Construction: Filled with a whole-piece microfiber filling featuring tight stitching to prevent the fill from shifting or clumping.
  • All-Season Comfort: Designed to provide comfortable warmth and lightweight breathability suitable for year-round use.
  • Easy Care: Fully machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on a low-heat or air-dry cycle to maintain its fluffiness.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D10
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Decor
Theme Number, Personalized
Seasons All
Customization 2 text inputs
Care Instructions Machine Wash
